This file documents the login resource over HTTP, one section per endpoint. Every section exports its own Hurl file into =projects/ores.http/scripts/library/=. Running a file sends that one request, so a failure names the endpoint it came from.

* Endpoints

** =POST /api/v1/iam/ops/login=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: 45882A82-4865-5B14-B10A-4513A5F62EE5
:END:

Login. It needs no session.

It forwards to =iam.v1.ops.login=.

The request is:

#+begin_example
POST /api/v1/iam/ops/login
#+end_example

#+name: login-login
#+begin_src hurl :tangle login-login.hurl :exports none
POST {{base_url}}/api/v1/iam/ops/login
Accept: application/json
HTTP 200
#+end_src

** =POST /api/v1/iam/ops/logout=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: 6504F620-1AC8-57AB-8593-E0B3464D47AE
:END:

Logout. It needs a session.

It forwards to =iam.v1.ops.logout=.

The request is:

#+begin_example
POST /api/v1/iam/ops/logout
#+end_example

#+name: login-logout
#+begin_src hurl :tangle login-logout.hurl :exports none
POST {{base_url}}/api/v1/iam/ops/logout
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
HTTP 200
#+end_src
